analysis.reasonEn: Previous 'buy' action shifted to 'wait-and-see'. ADX at 20.9 confirms weak trend. RSI at 44.9 enters neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but trend strength is weakening. Trend is progressing, remaining orders contingent on conditions. Sentiment balance is 35% positive vs 65% negative, with CPI and geopolitical tensions as key factors. Cumulative gain over last 5 trading days is +4.8%.
